title: Ash Rain
text: Grey flakes begin to fall from a sky with no fire under it, slow and fat as first snow. Where they land on skin they do not melt. They cling there, faintly warm, carrying the smell of a hearth that went cold long ago.

options.label: Cover your faces and wait out the grey, hoping it ends before it gets inside you.

outcomes.text: It falls through the night, soft as breath on the back of the neck. Not one of you sleeps; by morning every face is grey.

options.label: Walk on through it with your mouths shut. It is only ash, after all.

outcomes.text: The Leader breathes in more than they meant to. They cough grey through the next day, short of the breath their spells require.
It works its way into eyes, lungs and the joints of every helm, grinding there like grave dirt.

options.label: The Ravager smears it across their face, welcoming the dead hearth's warmth.

outcomes.text: The Ravager grins out from a face as grey as a corpse's. The dead hearth's heat settles in their limbs, waiting for the next fight.
